label: Indian
description: Indian-theme music for AI video: classical (Hindustani, Carnatic), folk, devotional, instruments (sitar, tabla, bansuri, veena) and Indian-style background tracks. Openly licensed, each file with a name and a credit.
overlap_policy: No node repeats a node of sources.v1.graph.json: every v2 node has its own query scope and its own url (checked by audio/check-graph.mjs). At clip level, nothing already stored in audio/v1 is stored again (same source key, same file hash, or same title).

nodes.name: Wikimedia Commons: category tree Music of India
nodes.license_policy: CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA
nodes.notes: 702 audio files in the category tree (checked with the MediaWiki search API). v1 A01 searched 33 general themes, not categories.

nodes.name: Wikimedia Commons: category tree Carnatic music
nodes.notes: 148 audio files, several are WAV (kept as WAV originals).

nodes.name: Wikimedia Commons: category tree Musical instruments of India
nodes.notes: 101 audio files: drums, strings, wind instruments.

nodes.name: Wikimedia Commons: Indian instrument and genre keywords
nodes.notes: Counts from the API: sitar 51, tabla 59, raga 148, bansuri 74, veena 250, santoor 9, sarod 4, bhajan 14, qawwali 3, bollywood 17. Overlap with B01-B03 is dropped at clip level.

nodes.name: ccMixter: Indian instrument tags
nodes.notes: Counts: sitar 22, tabla 12, indian 10, bollywood 1 (before the licence filter). v1 A02 used general mood tags.

nodes.name: Internet Archive: Indian music with an open licence
nodes.scope: subjects sitar, tabla, raga, indian classical
nodes.license_policy: only items whose licenseurl is CC0, public domain mark, CC BY or CC BY-SA
nodes.notes: 658 items match 'sitar' alone, most are NonCommercial or have no licence field: the licence filter keeps a small part. Each kept clip is the item's first MP3/Ogg file under 20 MB.

excluded.name: Openverse API
excluded.reason: did not answer from this machine in v1; still excluded

excluded.name: Free Music Archive, Jamendo, Freesound, Pixabay
excluded.reason: need an API key or login

excluded.name: YouTube 'no copyright' Indian music channels
excluded.reason: channel terms only, no per-file licence, not redistributable

excluded.name: Internet Archive VintageSense Indian Music series
Wikipedia pronunciation files for Hindi, Tamil, Bengali words
